originalFamilyScopeSummary: Fix Add Funds navigation stack corruption from order entry (TAT-3131): visiting Add Funds from the Perps order-entry screen left a phantom confirm-transaction history entry, breaking back navigation (double-tap) and post-trade navigation.
currentTriggerSummary: pr-complete re-entry: fix(perps): navigation issue when you tap "add funds" in order screen (PR #43367).
notes: PR #43367 fixes the original family scope at root cause: useConfirmActions.ts navigateBackToPreviousPage now returns navigate(goBackTo ?? DEFAULT_ROUTE, { replace: true }) instead of a push, removing the transient wallet-initiated confirmation from history (symmetric with the confirm-context auto-exit). The bundled TAT-3272 (Add Funds did nothing on a wallet without Arbitrum) is also resolved via the new usePerpsNetworkManagement.ensureArbitrumNetworkExists, called from usePerpsDepositConfirmation before creating the deposit tx. Family-inherited recipe re-run this session against a freshly rebuilt dist: 16/16 nodes pass, proving deposit opens (Arbitrum auto-added) and a single back tap returns to market detail. No code-behavior change was introduced this re-entry; the only edit was removing JIRA ticket numbers (TAT-3131) from two confirmations-owned code comments and condensing them so the @MetaMask/confirmations codeowners accept review. Unit suites (useConfirmActions, usePerpsDepositConfirmation, usePerpsNetworkManagement) pass 17/17; CI parity gate green.
